selection: lowest median R2 over 8 frozen train-row Query windows across OpenML12, no test-based selection
broadcast: encode visible cells, then broadcast original target carrier; Query seeds unchanged
residual: h=W e; f=h+U GELU(V h), bias-free, U=0, V initialized by fixed seed
optimizer: inherit AdamW moments for existing parameters; new parameters fresh with identical hyperparameters
comparison: equal successful training time, same per-update episode prefix; update counts may differ
scope: single-table empirical fitting exploration; no theoretical upper-bound or unseen-table claim
